items.title: Andrew Bailey Interview, 1959-09-26
items.q: Now I know one of the good piano players he did, that was Pelabon.

ctx.x: In the old days? No. They didn't have a piano player or?
Well they had some houses you catch, piano player. Now I know one of the good piano players he did, that was Pelabon. You might have heard of him Pelabon, Eugene Pelabon.
